items.title: RCE in Gnupg
items.summary: A critical double‑free vulnerability in GPGME (all versions prior to 2.3.1) allows remote code execution via crafted OpenPGP user IDs.
items.why_it_matters: Any CI/CD pipeline or automation that signs artifacts with GPGME is at immediate risk and must be patched.
items.next_step_detail: Upgrade GPGME to version 2.3.1: `sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install libgpgme-dev=2.3.1`

items.title: I chaos-tested my AI agent's LLM provider. 66% of runs failed, and the fix was one argument.
items.summary: The author built RunWeave, an open‑source chaos‑testing harness for AI agents, and discovered that a single client argument eliminated a 66 % failure rate caused by provider rate‑limits and hangs.
items.why_it_matters: Demonstrates a concrete, low‑effort way to harden production agents against LLM provider instability.
items.next_step_detail: Clone https://github.com/iammkd/runweave and run `pip install -e . && python -m runweave example_agent.py` to reproduce the test.
